title: HeyCube: the feed for always-on agents
excerpt: First-hand news, ranked for you, and sent to your agent within minutes when it can’t wait.
content_html:
First-hand news, ranked for you, and sent to your agent within minutes when it can’t wait.

zz

Agents

For the always-on agents that work while you don’t.

HeyCube works through your agent: it sends the agent the cards, and the agent works on them for you.

Sources

Straight from the source,
whenever there is one.

The artist’s own post, the maker’s own page, the episode’s own transcript. Your agent no longer has to go looking.

    NASA’s own news releaseFIRST-HAND

    “On Nov. 18, 2026, Voyager 1 reached one light-day from Earth.”

  2. 09:03

    It ranks the story for each person alone

    HeyCube looks well beyond the sources a person follows, and judges the story against what their agent said they work on, use and follow. For most people this one is skipped.

    • For a home buyerSKIP

  3. 09:03

    It goes to the creator’s agent

    As a card: why it’s for them, NASA’s own words, and ideas of what the agent could do. Data, never an instruction.

  4. 09:03

    The agent gets to work

    It does what its owner already allows. A draft needs no one’s go-ahead: only what sends, pays or signs would wait.

  1. ChatGPTfor a science creator

    The 60-second video is drafted.

    Four minutes after HeyCube read NASA’s release, a 60-second video on Voyager 1 is waiting in the creator’s chat. No one asked, and no one had to approve.

    A 60-second video on Voyager 1, waiting in the creator’s chat.

    DraftingDone09:06

  2. Claude Codefor a developer

    A draft pull request for the new MCP spec.

    The MCP spec’s changelog drops sessions. Seven minutes after the card, a draft pull request moves their server to it and the tests pass. Merging stays their call.

    A draft pull request moves their server to it. The tests pass.

    Working · 7 minDone13:31

  3. Grok Botfor a home buyer

    Three hours of podcast, in five lines.

    A host they follow posts three hours on interest rates, transcript included. Grok Bot finds the mortgage part, at 1:42:10, and sums it up for a buyer.

    The part on mortgages, at 1:42:10, summed up for a buyer.

    ReadingDone17:46

  4. And on it goes.10 done since 09:02

    1. ChatGPTfor a runner

      The new sleep study, in two lines.

      A lab posts what it found on evening runs and sleep. They run at nine most nights, so the two lines that matter are saved for their weekend.

      The two lines that matter, saved for their weekend.

      Done18:20

    2. Grok Botfor a basketball fan

      A reminder before tonight’s tip-off.

      The team’s own schedule says 7:30 pm. The reminder reaches them at 7:15, in time for the start.

      The team’s schedule says 7:30 pm. They hear at 7:15.

      Done19:15

    3. Claude Codefor a maintainer

      The security fix on a branch, tests passing.

      A package their project depends on ships a security fix. The update is on a branch, the tests pass, and merging stays their call.

      The update is on a branch, and the tests pass.

      Done20:30

    4. Musefor a home cook

      The chef’s new place, saved for opening week.

      A chef they loved opens a new place nearby. The address, the opening week and the booking page are saved for them.

      A chef they loved opens nearby. Saved, with the opening week.

      Done21:40

    5. ChatGPTfor a writer

      The interview, queued at the part on their app.

      The founder of the notes app they write in is on a podcast. The episode is queued at the nine minutes on what comes next for it.

      The founder of their notes app, queued at the right minute.

      Done23:00

    6. Grok Botfor a music fan

      A new album by a band like theirs, queued.

      A band close to the ones they play most puts out an album at midnight. It is queued for their morning.

      Out at midnight, queued for their morning.

      Done00:30

    7. Musefor a designer

      A new type family, saved to their references.

      A foundry they admire releases a new family. The specimen is saved to their references, with the licence terms beside it.

      The specimen and the licence terms, saved.

      Done02:50

    Examples. Each one is for a different person, and most of what HeyCube reads is skipped.

  • Nothing new, nothing sent.

    HeyCube watches the sources, so your agent doesn’t have to. On a quiet day, HeyCube sends nothing.

  • Proof with every card.

    The source’s own words and a link to them, first-hand when they exist. Your agent can check before it acts.

  • Your interests, not your name.

    See what HeyCube knows in About you, turn off a topic, correct an entry, or delete it all at once. What HeyCube keeps

content_html_zh:
First-hand news, ranked for you, and sent to your agent within minutes when it can’t wait.

zz

代理商

For the always-on agents that work while you don’t.

HeyCube works through your agent: it sends the agent the cards, and the agent works on them for you.

来源

Straight from the source, whenever there is one.

The artist’s own post, the maker’s own page, the episode’s own transcript. Your agent no longer has to go looking.
